posts.trend: IIT, IIM paychecks hit pause as median campus salaries stay flat for Class of 2027
posts.context: Middle-class parents compare current entry-level economics with historical real estate markets.
posts.angle: Parents assume modern financial struggles are caused by lifestyle choices rather than macroeconomics.
slides: Your father forwarded an article about campus placements from 1998.

"In my time, an IIT grad bought three grounds in Pune."
"Now you boys just order organic cold brew."
"Where is the money going?"
"We had no AC."

He thinks the problem is your coffee.

Not the interest rate.
posts.caption: Whose father still thinks a premium degree automatically buys a three-bedroom flat? 🏡
posts.rank_verdict: The final line acts as a logical economic correction rather than an unexpected comedic punchline.
